Born in Cleveland to Emanuel and Julia (Kretch) Weidenthal, he began his newspaper career as a reporter for the Cleveland World; then for the Cleveland Leader and in 1906, for the Plain Dealer on the city hall beat. His retirement in 1964 served as the catalyst for a reorganization of Cleveland’s Jewish press by a civic group incorporated as the Cleveland Jewish Publication Company.
